components.name: Proofing Intent Field
components.description: A warm-white field for the creator's one-baton intent.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;color:var(--ink,#121212);font-family:'DM Sans','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif}.ds-field>span{font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.ds-field textarea{min-height:110px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cfc5b5);background:#fffdf8;color:var(--ink,#121212);padding:13px;border-radius:9px;font:400 16px/1.55 'DM Sans','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;resize:vertical}.ds-field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--blue,#173be8)}.ds-field textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#173be8);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Proofing Table
components.description: The signature split work surface for rule controls and candidate proofs.
components.html:
接力规则

只改变一个视觉维度。

选择一个版本继续传递。
components.css: .ds-proof-table{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.75fr 1.25fr;border:1px solid var(--ink,#121212);background:var(--paper-2,#fbf7ef);color:var(--ink,#121212);box-shadow:0 22px 55px rgba(34,26,15,.14);font-family:'DM Sans','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif}.ds-proof-table>div{padding:28px}.ds-proof-table>div+div{border-left:1px solid var(--ink,#121212)}.ds-proof-table strong{font-size:18px}.ds-proof-table p{color:var(--ink-soft,#4e4a43);margin:12px 0 0}.ds-proof-table:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#173be8);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-proof-table{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-proof-table>div+div{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--ink,#121212)}}

components.name: Candidate Proof
components.description: An artwork proof that gains a blue registration border when selected.
components.css: .ds-candidate{width:180px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cfc5b5);background:var(--paper,#f2eadb);color:var(--ink,#121212);padding:6px;border-radius:11px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}.ds-candidate:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}.ds-candidate.is-selected,.ds-candidate[aria-pressed='true']{border:3px solid var(--blue,#173be8);padding:4px}.ds-candidate:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#173be8);outline-offset:3px}.ds-candidate-art{display:block;aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--blue,#173be8),var(--red,#ff482e) 55%,var(--acid,#d9ff2f))}.ds-candidate>span:last-child{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:9px 3px 3px;font:500 11px/1.3 'DM Sans','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif}.ds-candidate small{color:var(--ink-soft,#4e4a43)}

components.name: Top Navigation Item
components.description: A quiet workbench destination that fills with fresh proof paper when active.
components.html: 接力广场创作台
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:4px;font-family:'DM Sans','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif}.ds-nav a{padding:8px 13px;border-radius:9px;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft,#4e4a43)}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a.is-active{background:var(--paper-2,#fbf7ef);color:var(--ink,#121212)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#173be8);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Lineage Rail Node
components.description: A connected artwork node used as both provenance and navigation.
components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;gap:8px}.ds-rail-node{width:62px;height:72px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cfc5b5);border-radius:9px;background:var(--paper-2,#fbf7ef);padding:5px;position:relative;cursor:pointer}.ds-rail-node:not(:last-child)::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:50%;right:-9px;width:8px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink,#121212)}.ds-rail-node span{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--red,#ff482e),var(--blue,#173be8))}.ds-rail-node:hover,.ds-rail-node.is-active{border:2px solid var(--blue,#173be8);padding:4px}.ds-rail-node:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#173be8);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.northStar: Relay Proofing Table / 接力校样台
narrative.overview:
AI Remix Relay looks like an active screen-printing workbench: warm stock, dense ink, bright registration colors, proof sheets, and marks that show how one version leads to the next. The art leads; interface chrome behaves like practical studio equipment rather than a dashboard.

The system makes lineage tangible. Borders, rails, parent-child connectors, candidate proofs, and receipts show that an AI work is a baton to pass onward, not a terminal output. Product truth stays visible in compact status language instead of being buried behind Web3 vocabulary.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper field with near-black structural ink.
Electric blue for the primary handoff action; red and acid yellow as registration accents.
Oversized, tightly tracked headlines paired with compact proofing labels.
Flat bordered surfaces, interrupted by one deliberate proof-table shadow.
Artwork, node rails, and lineage diagrams act as navigation.

rules.name: The Registration Ink Rule
rules.body: Blue marks the action or selection; red and acid yellow add authored emphasis. Do not distribute all three accents evenly across a surface.

rules.name: The Honest Status Rule
rules.body: Green and amber describe verifiable state only; they do not decorate neutral content.

rules.name: The Poster/Proof Rule
rules.body: Headlines speak in short, oversized lines; operational truth uses compact labels and tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Art-First Rule
rules.body: In task entry views, a current work and its lineage occupy at least as much visual authority as its controls.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Keep working surfaces flat by default; reserve strong elevation for the proofing table, the active drawer, or a direct hover response.

dos: Do let artwork, candidate proofs, and lineage nodes carry navigation.
Do use blue consistently for the next consequential action, selection, and focus.
Do expose real, local, pending, and unconnected states in plain language.
Do collapse the workbench into a linear mobile flow without hiding the creative loop.
donts: Don't turn the home surface into a KPI dashboard, admin table, or wallet-first portal.
Don't use every accent color on every component; registration inks need rarity.
Don't add generic glassmorphism, gradient washes, or ornamental shadows.
Don't claim AI, Circuit, contract, payment, or publishing integrations without verifiable evidence.
